description: This source file provides an implementation of a subset of the pthreads API for Windows platforms, enabling thread creation, joining, and condition variable waiting functionalities. It is tailored specifically for Git's use case and includes platform-specific thread management code.

classes.name: pthread_t
classes.description: Structure representing a thread, including thread ID, handle, routine, and argument.

methods.name: unsigned __stdcall win32_start_routine(void * arg)
methods.description: Static function executing the start routine for a thread, setting thread ID and running the provided routine.

methods.name: int pthread_create(pthread_t * thread,const void * attr UNUSED,void * (* start_routine)(void *),void * arg)
methods.description: Creates a new thread executing the specified start routine with given argument.

methods.name: int win32_pthread_join(pthread_t * thread,void ** value_ptr)
methods.description: Joins with a thread, waiting for its completion and retrieving its return value.

methods.name: pthread_t pthread_self(void)
methods.description: Returns the current thread's pthread_t identifier.

methods.name: int pthread_cond_wait(pthread_cond_t * cond,pthread_mutex_t * mutex)
methods.description: Waits on a condition variable with an associated mutex, using Windows condition variable API.

ctags.name: pthread_create
ctags.signature: (pthread_t * thread,const void * attr UNUSED,void * (* start_routine)(void *),void * arg)
